info.title: Getnet Merchant Assistant
info.description: Multi-agent support system: Router, Knowledge, Customer Support, Escalation and Personality.

post.description:
OAuth 2.0 token endpoint (RFC 6749, form encoded). `password` for the synthetic demo users and
`client_credentials` for services. The response is `{access_token, token_type, expires_in, scope}`; a failure
never says which field was wrong.
Revokes the presented token (its `jti`) until it expires (RFC 7009 style: `200` with an empty body).

get.description: Operator queue, newest first; `state` = open, claimed, answered, rejected or closed.
Summary, pending question, draft, masked conversation, events and deliveries of one case.

post.description: Claims the case for the operator of the token (D9). Claiming one's own case again is idempotent.

`approve`, `reply` or `reject` (D9, D10, D14). The same `idempotency_key` returns the stored record with
`replayed: true`; a case already resumed by another action is `409 already_resumed`.

get.description: Public signing keys of the assistant's token issuer (RS256, `kid` = RFC 7638 thumbprint).

schema.title: Response Openid Configuration  Well Known Openid Configuration Get

post.description:
Sends one merchant message. A bearer access token is required: the merchant comes from the
token's principal, never from the payload (`user_id` is optional and, when present, must match it, otherwise
`403 identity_mismatch`). Operator, service and admin tokens receive `403`.

Two calls: get a token (OAuth 2.0 password grant), then send the message with it.

```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s localhost:8000/v1/auth/token -d grant_type=password -d username=cliente1988   -d password=cliente1988-fictitious | python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["access_token"])')
curl -s localhost:8000/messages -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -d '{"message": "When will the money from yesterday sales be deposited?"}'
```

In this page: get the token with `POST /v1/auth/token`, press **Authorize** and paste the `access_token`. The
passwords of `.env.example` are fictitious examples; replace them before exposing the API.

message.title: Message

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Optional. The merchant comes from the session; when present it must be the session's merchant (otherwise 403 identity_mismatch). It never selects the merchant.
